text:
maya_sales: Heads-up: customer 'NovaHealth' on a live POC reported their free credits dropped from 5k -> 0 during a 10-min demo. They ran three scripted prompts. Help?

eli_support: Account id? Any request ids or headers they shared?

maya_sales: nova-poc. They pasted one header: x-req-id=req_aa12bb and x-total-tokens: 45123. They expected ~4.5k tokens, not 45k.

chao_billing: Billing alert flagged multiple high-token events from that account around 2026-03-28T14:22Z. I'm pulling invoice lines.

eli_support: Quick triage: are they using streaming or sync? SDK version?

maya_sales: Using our Java SDK 2.0.0, synchronous generate. They said their test harness retries on socket read timeouts.

ops-zoe: I grep logs: I see a burst of identical payloads with different req ids from one client IP between 14:21:58 and 14:22:05. Server returned 502 a few times, then 200 for each retry. Snippet:
```
2026-03-28T14:21:58 req=req_aa12bb status=502
2026-03-28T14:21:59 req=req_aa12bc status=200 tokens=45123
2026-03-28T14:22:00 req=req_aa12bd status=200 tokens=45123
```

eli_support: That looks like a retry storm with large-token responses counted each time. For sync generates we don't currently de-duplicate based on payload hash; each successful response is billed.

chao_billing: We can issue a one-off credit for the duplicate events once support confirms expected token usage.

maya_sales: Customer is nervous about billing and contract signing. Can we offer a temporary credit and mitigation steps?

eli_support: Proposed steps to customer: 1) We'll apply a provisional credit to match their expected ~4.5k tokens (applied within 24h). 2) Ask them to upgrade Java SDK to 2.1.2 which adds client-side idempotency keys for sync calls. 3) Recommend exponential backoff with jitter instead of immediate retries. 4) Ask for any request ids if they see spikes.

ops-zoe: Engineering follow-up: we'll add server-side small-payload dedupe (content-hash + account + 30s window) for sync generate calls. ETA 72h. Also adding an alert to detect >x identical payloads in 1m.

chao_billing: Noted. I'll flag invoice lines and hold any charge notices.

maya_sales: Customer accepted the provisional credit. They requested a one-paragraph explainer for their compliance team. Eli, can you draft and I'll send?

eli_support: Drafting now: short blurb explaining root cause (retry due to transient 502s led to duplicate successful responses billed separately), steps taken (credit, SDK upgrade, server dedupe ETA), and recommended client best-practices. Will paste here in a minute.

sdk-bot: FYI SDK release 2.1.2 published with idempotency header for sync generate calls: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-java/releases/tag/v2.1.2

maya_sales: Thanks everyone. Please update when the dedupe patch is merged so I can close the loop with legal. :pray:
